title: Update client pages - remove useVisitorId, require auth for data
description: Update all client pages to remove useVisitorId usage. Data queries now use ctx.auth server-side, so client just needs to be authenticated.

acceptanceCriteria.text: dashboard.tsx: Remove useVisitorId import and usage
dashboard.tsx: Remove visitorId from all query calls
settings.tsx: Remove useVisitorId import and usage
settings.tsx: Remove visitorId from all query calls
leaderboard.tsx: Remove useVisitorId import and usage
leaderboard.tsx: Remove visitorId from all query calls
song.$songId.tsx: Remove useVisitorId import and usage
song.$songId.tsx: Remove visitorId from all query calls
welcome.tsx: Remove useVisitorId import and usage
Verify in browser: dashboard loads for authenticated user

notes:
BEFORE:
```typescript
const visitorId = useVisitorId();
const progress = useQuery(api.wordProgress.getByVisitor, { visitorId });
```

AFTER:
```typescript
// No visitorId needed - server uses ctx.auth
const progress = useQuery(api.wordProgress.getByUser);
```

The queries now get the user from ctx.auth server-side, so the client doesn't need to pass any user identifier.

Search for all files using useVisitorId:
```bash
grep -r 'useVisitorId' src/
```

Update each one to remove the hook and update query calls.
